text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
H-Happy birthday! Here... you said you 
wanted to eat Japanese sweets, right?!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, come to think of it... I may have 
mentioned that—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Still, that was quite a while ago. ...Did 
you really remember?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—Huh!? Not really!? It was just a 
coincidence!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You got a problem with that?! Then I'll 
just eat it myself, you hear?!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
?? Yes, if you'd like to eat it, please go 
ahead.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
THAAAT'S NOOOT IIIIIT!! Ugh, come on, just 
take it! Hurry up and accept it already!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I may accept this, yes? Then, with my 
deepest gratitude.
